title: Cute Concept
text: Cute Concept. I've always gone all out with Advent calendars for my kids. They're both in college now, but I still like making them for them. We used to have little cabinet type thing with drawers, but that really limited what I could put in them. These little bags give me more flexibility. The bags are decent. They're small but nicely made. The dates are just stickers and the stickers don't stick really well to the burlap bags. Plus, the little clothespins are more for decoration and can't hold much weight. Overall, I think this is a cute concept, but needs some improvements.
